text:
jenna: Heads-up — kicking off tenant index swap migration tonight 00:30 UTC. tagging @samuel and ops-runbooks. deploybot scheduled. risk: replica lag spike seen in last dry-run.

samuel: Ack. I'll watch replicas and locks. Abort condition?

jenna: Abort if replica lag > 10s or sustained pg_locks > 8s. Rollback plan = pin schema_version to previous (v20251111_02) and run DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY new_tenant_idx. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mig-index-swap

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled migration 'tenant_index_swap_v3' for 2025-11-12T00:30Z. Canary step queued (5% traffic).

kevin: Quick Q — are writers quiesced during build? we should set a short write-freeze flag for the swap window.

maria: I can flip the flag. API endpoint: `POST /internal/flags` body `flag=tenants.index_swap&on=true`. I'll flip at 00:25.

samuel: Preflight checks: watch metric `replica_delay` and `pg_locks`. Action: escalate at replica_delay > 8s or lock_hold > 5s.

jenna: Preflight SQL to estimate backfill: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM tenants WHERE created_at < now() - interval '90 days';
-- sampled output: 120345
```

ops-runbooks: Runbook snippet: escape hatch -> 1) abort canary, 2) pin schema_version=20251111_02, 3) restart writer tier if WAL backlog > 30s, 4) notify SRE, 5) roll forward only after manual signoff.

kevin: If we see lock escalations trigger `deploy-bot hold` with reason `lock_surges`. I'll be on standby to unpin if safe.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started — 5% traffic. Observing initial metrics: latency +3ms, error rate 0.2% (2/1000).

maria: flipped flag at 00:25 :white_check_mark:

samuel: Replica lag creeping 4s -> 9s, nearing our threshold.

jenna: Reduce blast radius: drop canary to 1% and pause background backfill. deploy-bot, reduce canary and pause job `tenant_idx_fill`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scaling canary to 1% and pausing background job 'tenant_idx_fill'.

kevin: Also enabling safemode: `safemode.lock_timeout=2000ms` for canary region.

maria: Adding note to release notes: "index swap — phased canary, temporary write-freeze, backfill paused on contention."

jenna: Decision: continue at 1% for 10m. Escalate if replica lag > 12s or locks > 10s. Rollback if user-facing errors > 0.5% or any 5xx spike.

samuel: I'll OT-watch the window. Ping me if alarm at any time.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary complete at 00:40 UTC. No rollback triggered. Proceeding to wave2 (50% traffic) per rollout policy.

kevin: Thanks team — keep an eye on lag during wave2. I'll stand by for manual unpin if needed.

jennA (typo check): noted and closing watch after wave2 stabilizes. :thumbsup:
